A green regression arm proves nothing without a null control; an arm that could never go red conceals drift.

Enumeration drift must fail loudly: conflating the 35 exported brand constructors with the 19 AuditBrandKind members under-sized the rejected instance-scope model.

Compatibility records must classify the chosen scope so a future reader cannot mistake a no-op formalization for a behavioral security tightening.

approach-instance-scoped-authority.reason: Instance scope would make cross-instance values foreign even inside one module copy, a behavior change from today, and would require every one of the 35 exported brand constructors to become instance-bound, factory-returned, or instance-parameterized — a breaking change across the entire authority surface that option C obtains structurally without. The owner rejected instance scope on 2026-08-23 and this change may not re-litigate it.

approach-global-registry-singleton.reason: A globalThis-anchored registry is reachable and mutable by any code in the process, replacing the constructor-only insertion boundary with ambient process reachability. It would accept cross-copy values by weakening authority provenance instead of proving Core resolution, and it was explicitly rejected for every option so that it is not re-proposed.

approach-absorb-duplicate-diagnostic.reason: Adding the diagnostic path here would change runtime behavior and take ownership away from #79, whose body stays as written and whose distinct duplicate-Core diagnostic is implemented separately after this change. The copy arm in this change must assert the existing bounded AUTHORITY_ESCALATION rejection, not a new message.

security_justification.audit_integrity: The change makes trusted context-brand recognition explicit and regression-guarded while preserving the fail-closed rejection before event construction or sink handoff.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Brand membership distinguishes authoritative values from claims; the formalization changes no authentication flow or authorization grant but protects that distinction from silent drift.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Only constructors in one context.ts module copy may add registry entries; casts, plain objects, clones, and ambient state remain unable to establish provenance, now asserted by tests rather than left to the implementation.
security_justification.concurrency: Nested and concurrent AsyncLocalStorage arms preserve existing isolation with no new mutable shared state; no coordination primitive is added.
security_justification.confidentiality: No caller data, event payload, secret, or diagnostic content is added; the copy-arm rejection carries code, category, and bounded path only.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic primitive, key material, hash, signature, or cryptographic trust assumption changes.
security_justification.error_disclosure: The AUTHORITY_ESCALATION shape is preserved; no new diagnostic is added, and #79 remains responsible for a bounded distinct diagnostic that does not disclose payload or raw runtime errors.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No exporter, collector, SIEM, transport, browser telemetry, analytics, detection, or external security service is introduced or authorized.
security_justification.fail_posture: Forged, cloned, and cross-copy values fail closed before the sink; the matrix makes that posture observable and mutation-tested.
security_justification.lifecycle: No initialization, shutdown, delivery, queue, retry, or persistence behavior changes; the cleanup arm verifies existing scope-exit behavior.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: This change owns formalization, tests, and compatibility classification only; #79 owns the distinct duplicate-Core diagnostic and #86 owns the single-copy Core proof and dependency-gate rescoping.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No personal, browser, client, event, or derived data is collected, transformed, retained, or exposed.
security_justification.resource_retention: The module-private WeakMap ownership model remains unchanged; no new cache, global store, durable resource, or retention policy is created.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: The change adds no delivery, retry, redelivery, queue, buffering, or durability behavior.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The chosen model retains module-private authority and a genuine two-copy fixture proves cross-copy rejection, rather than broadening trust through global process state.
